title: Hellinger contraction with biased Boolean outputs
exact_target: For every Boolean f on a uniform n-dimensional discrete cube and every correlation $\rho \in [-1,1]$, is $H(Ef)-E$ $H(T_\rho f)\leq 1-H(\rho )$, where $H(a)=\surd (1-a^{2})$ and $T_\rho $ is coordinatewise noise?

sources.citation: OpenAI, manuscript citation page. Source of the formulation motivating this local problem.

manuscripts.title: Hellinger contraction with arbitrary Boolean output bias
